scope: Reviewed ACK plus bounded provider patch and captured DT; no hardware execution
subdomain: MFG under MFG_ASYNC in both source models; clock attachment changes
bus_protection: MM, MFG_ASYNC and CONN use unchanged masks; ACK poll/ack paths retained, no ignore-clear-ack or protection bypass introduced

probe_effects: If INIT_DONE2 clear, reset/reinitialize wrapper and PMIC transport; initialization is not a read-only observation

runtime_limit: Register/ID agreement and generic Image compilation do not validate voltage, clock/power ordering, suspend wakeup or recovery after failed experimental boot.
